name: Korea Aerospace Industries, Ltd.
summary: Korea Aerospace Industries, Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, satellites, launch vehicles, and aerospace components in South Korea and internationally. The company offers trainer aircraft, fighter aircraft, helicopters, satellite and space systems, simulators, and aircraft structures for commercial aerospace applications. It also provides aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul services, as well as satellite communication components, avionics, testing equipment, and other aerospace-related products and services. Korea Aerospace Industries, Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Sacheon-si, South Korea.
